shortDescription: Query FortiManager data objects for use in Ansible workflows.

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: custom_dict
options.description: ADVANCED USERS ONLY! REQUIRES KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API! DICTIONARY JSON FORMAT ONLY -- Custom dictionary/datagram to send to the endpoint.

options.name: custom_endpoint
options.description: ADVANCED USERS ONLY! REQUIRES KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API! The HTTP Endpoint on FortiManager you wish to GET from.

options.name: device_ip
options.description: The IP of the device you want to query.

options.name: device_serial
options.description: The serial number of the device you want to query.

options.name: device_unique_name
options.description: The desired "friendly" name of the device you want to query.

options.name: nodes
options.description: A LIST of firewalls in the cluster you want to verify i.e. ["firewall_A","firewall_B"].

options.name: object
options.description: The data object we wish to query (device, package, rule, etc). Will expand choices as improves.

options.name: task_id
options.description: The ID of the task you wish to query status on. If left blank and object = 'task' a list of tasks are returned.
